game.title: Ludo (Desi Version)
game.description: Pakistani version of the classic board game, descended from the ancient Indian game Pachisi. Played with cowrie shells instead of dice in traditional settings.
howToPlay: Step 1: Players choose colored pieces and place them in the starting area.
Step 2: Throw cowrie shells to determine moves (number of shells opening up determines count).
Step 3: Move pieces around the board according to the throw.
Step 4: Landing on an opponent's square sends their piece back to start.
Step 5: Safe squares protect pieces from capture.
Step 6: To enter the home column, piece must land exactly on the entrance square.
Step 7: All pieces must reach the center to win.
Step 8: Strategy involves deciding which pieces to move and when.
Step 9: The first player to get all pieces home wins.
Step 10: Traditional version uses cowrie shells instead of modern dice.
